# HealthO Pro

> HealthO Pro is a cloud-enabled healthcare software suite built by Healthocare Private Limited (India). It includes HIMS for hospitals, LIMS for diagnostic laboratories, CIMS for clinics and polyclinics, and RIS/RIMS for radiology and imaging centers. The company has served healthcare providers since 2011 and has 1,200+ clients in 8 countries: India, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Egypt and Canada.

Key facts:

- Company: Healthocare Private Limited. Brand: HealthO Pro. Website: https://healtho.pro
- History: founded in 2011 as Hallys IT, expanded as IncraSoft Private Limited in 2015, rebranded as Healthocare Private Limited in 2023.
- Headquarters: India. Markets served: India, the GCC (UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait), Egypt and Canada.
- Deployment: cloud-enabled and used in a web browser. Secure by design, with role-based access, audit trails and encrypted data.
- Scale: from single-doctor clinics to multi-site hospital chains. 24×7 support. Onboarding is included.
- Pricing: HIMS, LIMS and CIMS come in Startup, Business and Enterprise plans with a choice of billing cycles. Yearly billing saves up to 20%. RIS/RIMS is pay-as-you-go at ₹5 per patient, with no fixed licence fee.
- Free demo: https://healtho.pro/contact
- Sales: +91 97007 30044, sales@healtho.pro. Support: +91 97007 10055, support@healtho.pro

## Products

- [HIMS: Hospital Information Management System](https://healtho.pro/hims): OPD/IPD with real-time bed status, patient registration with UHID and ABHA support, EMR/EHR, cash, credit, insurance/TPA and package billing with GST-ready invoices, pharmacy and inventory (batch/expiry tracking, reorder alerts), built-in lab and radiology integration, analytics and MIS dashboards.
- [LIMS: Laboratory Information Management System](https://healtho.pro/lims): barcoded sample registration and chain-of-custody tracking, bi-directional integration with biochemistry, hematology and immunoassay analyzers, automated validation, QC with Levey-Jennings charts, branded reports via WhatsApp, email and a patient portal, B2B collection centers and referral doctors, TAT analytics.
- [CIMS: Clinic Information Management System](https://healtho.pro/cims): online and walk-in appointments, token and queue management, e-prescriptions with dosage templates, central EMR, billing and online payments, automated SMS/WhatsApp reminders, footfall and revenue reports.
- [RIS / RIMS: Radiology Information System](https://healtho.pro/ris): slot-based scheduling and modality worklists, CT/MRI/X-ray/ultrasound integration with PACS and DICOM viewers, structured templates, voice-to-text and radiologist e-signature, report and image sharing via link, WhatsApp and patient portal, pay-as-you-go at ₹5 per patient.
- [All solutions](https://healtho.pro/solutions): how the four products work together on one platform.
- [All features](https://healtho.pro/features): 73 features grouped by category, each with a guide.

## Feature guides

- [Blog](https://healtho.pro/blog): one guide per feature. Each guide explains what the feature does, why it matters, who it is built for, and answers common questions.

### Patient Experience & Front Desk

- [Appointment Booking](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=appointment-booking): Online and walk-in bookings with doctor slots, calendars and instant confirmations.
- [Follow-ups for Appointments](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=follow-ups-for-appointments): Schedule follow-up visits at consultation and remind patients automatically.
- [Token System](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=token-system): Digital tokens and queue display so patients know exactly when it is their turn.
- [Self QR](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=self-qr): Patients scan a QR code to register or check in themselves from their own phone.
- [Patient App](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=patient-app): A branded app for bookings, reports, bills and reminders in the patient’s pocket.
- [Patient Subscriptions](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=patient-subscriptions): Sell health plans and memberships with included visits, tests and renewals.
- [Privilege Card](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=privilege-card): Issue discount and loyalty cards that apply benefits automatically at billing.
- [Patients Review](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=patients-review): Collect patient feedback after every visit and grow your online reviews.

### Billing & Finance

- [Billing](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=billing): Fast OPD, IPD, lab and package billing with GST-ready invoices.
- [Manage Payments](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=manage-payments): Track collections, dues, advances and settlements across every payment mode.
- [Payment Modify](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=payment-modify): Correct payment entries through approvals, with every change logged.
- [Refunds](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=refunds): Approve and process full or partial refunds with reasons and records.
- [Expenses](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=expenses): Record daily expenses by category and branch to see true profitability.
- [Payment Gateway Integration](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=payment-gateway-integration): Accept online payments by link, app or website — reconciled automatically.

### Reports & Analytics

- [Dashboard](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=dashboard): A live view of patients, revenue, pending work and alerts across branches.
- [MIS Reports](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=mis-reports): Ready-made management reports on revenue, volumes, doctors and referrals.
- [Shift Reports](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=shift-reports): Close each shift with collections, work done and handover notes.
- [TATs](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=tats): Track turnaround time at every step and get alerts before reports run late.

### Clinical & Doctors

- [Medical Records](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=medical-records): A complete electronic record of every visit, report, prescription and document.
- [Prescription](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=prescription): Write clear digital prescriptions in seconds with templates and quick-pick drugs.
- [Medicines](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=medicines): A shared medicine master with strengths, forms and default dosages.
- [Case Taking](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=case-taking): Structured, detailed case history forms for thorough first consultations.
- [Medical Examination](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=medical-examination): Run pre-employment, corporate and periodic health check-ups end to end.
- [Transcriptor](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=transcriptor): Turn dictation into formatted reports with templates and voice-to-text.
- [Dr. Authorization](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=dr-authorization): Doctors review and digitally sign reports before they are released.
- [PNDT Form](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=pndt-form): Complete and store PCPNDT forms digitally for every ultrasound.
- [Doctors](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=doctors): Manage consulting and referring doctors, schedules, fees and payouts.

### Hospital & Inpatient

- [Nursing Station](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=nursing-station): Ward patients, medication rounds, vitals and nursing notes on one screen.
- [Surgeries](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=surgeries): Schedule OTs, surgical teams and procedure records with package billing.
- [Rooms](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=rooms): Real-time bed and room status with transfers and room-wise tariffs.
- [Blood Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=blood-management): Track donors, blood units, stock, cross-matching and issues.
- [Canteen Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=canteen-management): Run the hospital canteen — menus, orders, patient diets and billing.
- [Parking Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=parking-management): Record vehicle entry and exit, parking fees and passes.

### Laboratory & Diagnostics

- [Phlebotomist](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=phlebotomist): A collection worklist for phlebotomists with barcodes and collection times.
- [Home Sample Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=home-sample-management): Book, assign and track home sample collections from booking to lab receipt.
- [Tests Master](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=tests-master): Define tests, parameters, reference ranges, methods, prices and TATs.
- [Lab Packages](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=lab-packages): Create health check-up packages with bundled tests and package prices.
- [LIS Integration](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=lis-integration): Connect lab analyzers bi-directionally so results flow in without typing.
- [Inventory Management of Lab](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=inventory-management-of-lab): Track reagents and consumables with batches, expiry and reorder alerts.
- [Auto AI-Driven QC](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=auto-ai-driven-qc): AI-assisted quality control that flags QC shifts and trends automatically.
- [Referral Lab](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=referral-lab): Send tests you don’t run to partner labs and track them to the report.
- [Referral Dispatch](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=referral-dispatch): Dispatch samples and reports to partners and referrers, with proof of delivery.
- [B2B Collaboration](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=b2b-collaboration): Work with collection centers, hospitals and clinics on credit, with their own rates.

- [Web Integration](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=web-integration): Connect your website for online bookings, report downloads and enquiries.
- [Banner Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=banner-management): Publish promotional banners on your app and website from one place.
- [Bulk SMS](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=bulk-sms): Send reminders, alerts and campaigns by SMS to selected patient groups.
- [Official WhatsApp](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=official-whatsapp): Send reports, bills and reminders from your verified WhatsApp Business number.
- [Bulk Emails](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=bulk-emails): Email reports, statements, newsletters and campaigns to patients and partners.
- [Medical Representative Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=medical-representative-management): Plan and track field staff visits to doctors, and the business they bring.
- [Forms (Survey, Testimonials)](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=forms-survey-testimonials): Build surveys and collect testimonials with shareable online forms.

### AI & Automation

- [HealthO AI Assistant](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=healtho-ai-assistant): Ask questions about your data and get help with everyday tasks in plain language.
- [AI Call Agents](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=ai-call-agents): AI voice agents that answer and make calls for bookings, reminders and follow-ups.
- [Master Reminders](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=master-reminders): Automated reminders for renewals, calibrations, dues and recurring tasks.

### Team & HR

- [Team](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=team): Manage users, roles, permissions and branches for your whole team.
- [Team Chat](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=team-chat): Secure internal messaging between staff, departments and branches.
- [Tasks Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=tasks-management): Assign tasks with deadlines and track them to completion.
- [Staff Approvals](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=staff-approvals): Route discounts, leave, purchases and changes to the right approver.
- [Recruitment Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=recruitment-management): Post jobs, track applicants and move them through interviews to offer.
- [HR Records](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=hr-records): Digital employee files with documents, qualifications and history.
- [Timesheet & Leave](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=timesheet-and-leave): Attendance, shifts, timesheets and leave requests with approvals.
- [HR Payroll](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=hr-payroll): Monthly salaries from attendance and leave, with payslips and deductions.
- [Self KT & Learning](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=self-kt-and-learning): Self-paced training and knowledge transfer for new and existing staff.
- [Healthcare Hiring](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=healthcare-hiring): Reach healthcare professionals looking for work through the HealthO network.

### Administration & Operations

- [Master Data](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=master-data): Central masters for services, prices, departments, branches and more.
- [SOPs & DOCs](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=sops-and-docs): A controlled library of SOPs and documents with versions and acknowledgements.
- [Process Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=process-management): Define step-by-step workflows and see where each case is stuck.
- [Assets Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=assets-management): Register equipment and assets with location, warranty, AMC and maintenance.
- [Purchase Management](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=purchase-management): Indents, purchase orders, goods receipt and supplier bills in one flow.
- [Mail Box](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=mail-box): Read and send your facility’s emails from inside HealthO Pro.
- [Healthcare Vendors](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=healthcare-vendors): Find and manage suppliers of equipment, reagents and services.
- [Support](https://healtho.pro/blog-post?s=support): Raise and track support tickets with the HealthO Pro team from inside the app.
